## v5.3.0 Summary

### User-facing changes
- Added thumbnail support for JPEG XL (`.jxl`) images inside ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR, and 7z/CB7 archives.
- Bundled the `jxl-oxide` software decoder, so JPEG XL support does not require a separate WIC codec installation.
- Animated JPEG XL images produce a static thumbnail from the first frame.

### Release verification
- Windows x64 CI runs workspace tests before building release installers; ARM64 installers are cross-compiled.
- Release builds use the committed Cargo lockfile and verify that the release tag, Cargo package versions, and installer version agree.
- Manual release runs build the requested tag and load its release notes.

### 한국어 안내
- ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR, 7z/CB7 압축 파일 내부의 JPEG XL (`.jxl`) 이미지 썸네일을 지원합니다.
- `jxl-oxide` 디코더가 포함되어 별도의 WIC 코덱 설치가 필요하지 않습니다.
- 애니메이션 JPEG XL은 첫 프레임을 정적 썸네일로 표시합니다.
